rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: Oh brave hero, thank you for rescuing me and proving your courage.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 噢，勇敢的英雄，谢谢你救了我，证明了你的勇气。

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: Now, place your hands upon mine.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 现在，把你的双手放到我的手上。

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: Turn your mind inward and witness the events that have shaped these lands...
rows.current: lang(Fox): 让心神向内，去见证塑造这片土地的那些往事……

rows.source: ...I can see...!
rows.current: text: ……我看见了……！

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: We, the Fenfen, have lived for eons on this planet that you know as "Tutone".
rows.current: lang(Fox): 我们Fenfen，在这颗你们称为「图托恩」的星球上，已经生活了无数纪元。

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: Having eschewed the sort of technological advances that your culture thrives on
rows.current: lang(Fox): 摒弃了你们的文化赖以繁荣的那类技术进步之后，

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: we have lived simple, satisfying lives in harmony with the planet itself.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 我们与这颗星球和谐共生，过着简单而满足的生活。

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: Quiet and modest are the best ways to describe us Fenfen.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 安静谦逊，最适合形容我们Fenfen。

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: All major quarrels were sorted out by a council of the wisest ESPers we had.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 所有重大纷争，都由我们中最睿智的超能力者所组成的理事会来化解。

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: With our highly attuned senses and powers, we were able to find solutions that
rows.current: lang(Fox): 凭借我们高度敏锐的感官与力量，我们总能找到解决之道，这些方案

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: benefitted all of society at once.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 能让整个社会同时受益。

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: However, even with our attunement...
rows.current: lang(Fox): 然而，即便有着这份感应力……

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: ...we were not able to sense that amongst us ESPers lay one whose ambitions
rows.current: lang(Fox): ……我们竟未察觉，超能力者之中藏着一人，其野心

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: would throw the very planet itself into chaos...
rows.current: lang(Fox): 会将整颗星球本身都拖入混沌……

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.current: lang(Fox): ……

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: ...her name was Traeh.
rows.current: lang(Fox): ……她的名字是Traeh。

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: Gifted beyond her years, with an uncanny ability to find solutions others missed
rows.current: lang(Fox): 天赋远超其年纪，又有着总能找到他人所遗漏之解法的非凡本事，

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: the ESPer Traeh seemed like a fine addition to the council.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 超能力者Traeh，看上去是议会的一位出色新成员。

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: She was readily granted access to the stores of power that we Fenfen kept.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 她很轻易便获准接触我们Fenfen所封存的力量贮藏。

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: Power... that she then proceeded to corrupt.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 力量……而她随即着手将其腐化。

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: Absorbing ancient caches of ESPer power that were left by previous generations
rows.current: lang(Fox): 吸收了前代遗留下来的古老超能力者力量贮藏之后，

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: Traeh was left deeply disfigured, down to her very core.
rows.current: lang(Fox): Traeh从外貌到内心，都已扭曲得面目全非。

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: Maybe if we, the remaining elder ESPers of the council, reacted faster
rows.current: lang(Fox): 也许我们议会中剩下的超能力者长老若能更快应对

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: then we could've prevented the calamity that was about to befall our people.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 就本可以阻止那场即将降临到我们族人头上的灾难。

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: Alas, we did not, and that will forever be our greatest failing...
rows.current: lang(Fox): 可惜，我们没有，而这将永远是我们最大的过错……

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: Now go, destined hero.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 去吧，命中注定的英雄。

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: Free my brothers and sisters and restore peace to the land!
rows.current: lang(Fox): 解放我的兄弟姐妹，让这片土地重归和平！

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: Oh brave hero, thank you for rescuing me and proving your courage.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 噢，勇敢的英雄，谢谢你救了我，证明了你的勇气。

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: Now, place your hands upon mine.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 现在，把你的双手放到我的手上。

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: Turn your mind inward and witness the events that have shaped these lands...
rows.current: lang(Fox): 让心神向内，去见证塑造这片土地的那些往事……

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: When Traeh turned her aggressions to us remaining members of the ESPer council
rows.current: lang(Fox): 当Traeh把矛头转向我们超能力者议会的其余成员时，

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: it was unlike anything that we had ever encountered.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 那是我们从未遭遇过的情形。

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: We were a peaceful, though perhaps squabbly, folk!
rows.current: lang(Fox): 我们本是爱好和平的族群，虽说偶尔也爱拌拌嘴！

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: Violence and ESPer powered aggression were unknown to us!
rows.current: lang(Fox): 暴力，以及超能力者力量驱动的攻击，我们闻所未闻！

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: Traeh was not alone in her new ambitions, however.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 然而，怀有这番新野心的并非只有Traeh。

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: Formerly placable creatures began to rise up as though answering her call.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 向来温顺易处的生灵也纷纷起身，仿佛在响应她的召唤。

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: Their combined powers were frightening...
rows.current: lang(Fox): 它们汇聚起来的力量令人胆寒……

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: ...and it seemed as if all hope was lost!
rows.current: lang(Fox): ……而一切希望仿佛就此落空！

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: No amount of reason nor pleading would stop the newly emboldened creatures
rows.current: lang(Fox): 无论讲道理还是苦苦哀求，都挡不住那些陡然壮了胆的生灵

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: and even our cries for mercy went unanswered.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 连我们求饶的呼声也得不到半点回应。

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: Those very cries seemed to only fuel Traeh's power and ambition even more.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 那些哀嚎，似乎反而助长了Traeh的力量与野心。

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: With each new section of Tutone conquered she would set her eyes on another
rows.current: lang(Fox): 每征服图托恩一片土地，她便盯上下一片，

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: until it seemed that the very planet itself would bend to her will.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 直到仿佛整颗行星本身都要屈从于她的意志。

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: Any Fenfen that couldn't hide in the shadows of what we once called home
rows.current: lang(Fox): 任何无法躲进我们曾称之为家的阴影之下的Fenfen

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: became enslaved to do the bidding of the new conquerors.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 都沦为奴隶，听命于新的征服者。

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: This was no longer a quiet and modest life for us...
rows.current: lang(Fox): 我们的生活，再也谈不上安静谦逊了……

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: Yes, our very home seemed destined to fall under the cruel fist of Traeh.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 没错，我们的家园仿佛注定落入Traeh的残暴铁拳。

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: It was a level of cruelty that was unknown in the long history of us Fenfen
rows.current: lang(Fox): 这种残酷在我们Fenfen的漫长历史上前所未见

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: and it seemed as if all hope were lost...
rows.current: lang(Fox): 而一切希望仿佛都已不复存在……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Oh brave hero, thank you for rescuing me and proving your courage.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 噢，勇敢的英雄，谢谢你救了我，证明了你的勇气。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Now, place your hands upon mine.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 现在，把你的双手放到我的手上。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Turn your mind inward and witness the events that have shaped these lands...
rows.current: lang(Fox): 让心神向内，去见证塑造这片土地的那些往事……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: As dark forces descended on all Fenfen, young and old alike,
rows.current: lang(Fox): 当黑暗势力降临到全体Fenfen——无论老幼——头上时，

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: it truly did seem like all hope was lost.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 一切希望看起来当真都已破灭。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Powerful though the ESPers of our people may have been, violence was unknown to us.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 我们族中的超能力者纵然或许强大，暴力对我们却全然陌生。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Only when pushed to the end of options, when even surrender seemed impossible
rows.current: lang(Fox): 只有当被逼至绝路，连投降似乎都变得不可能时，

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: did the first of us strike out...
rows.current: lang(Fox): 我们中才有人第一个出手反抗……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: ...and retaliate!
rows.current: lang(Fox): ……并予以还击！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Psychic abilities once turned only towards a common good
rows.current: lang(Fox): 曾经只用于共同福祉的心灵能力，

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: would now be turned against those who would try to subjugate us Fenfen!
rows.current: lang(Fox): 如今要对准那些企图征服我们Fenfen的人！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: An arsenal of ESPer abilities became harnessed as weapons of war.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 各式各样的超能力，都被用作战争武器。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Explosive psychic projectiles blasted away foes.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 爆裂的灵能弹将敌人轰退。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Punishing waves of telekinetic force prevented advancement of armies.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 一波波慑人的念动力浪潮，挡住了大军的推进。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Some even went so far as to transform their very bodies into tools for combat.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 有些人甚至改变自己的身体，将其化作战斗的工具。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Ancient beings heard the cries of mental anguish that rang throughout the planet
rows.current: lang(Fox): 古老的存在们听见了回荡于整颗星球的精神痛呼，

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Some, like the noble Elves, took up ancient weapons in order to aid us Fenfen...
rows.current: lang(Fox): 其中一些，比如高贵的Elves，拿起了古老的武器来援助我们Fenfen……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: ...while other ancient beings, from deep within the bowels of the planet
rows.current: lang(Fox): ……而其他古老的存在，则从这颗星球最深的地底，

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: awoke with a desire for vengeance and domination of their own...
rows.current: lang(Fox): 带着属于它们自己的复仇与征服欲望苏醒了……

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: Oh brave hero, thank you for rescuing me and proving your courage.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 噢，勇敢的英雄，谢谢你救了我，证明了你的勇气。

rows.current: lang(Fox): 现在，把你的双手放到我的手上。

rows.source: Turn your mind inward and witness the events that have shaped these lands...
rows.current: lang(Fox): 让心神向内，去见证塑造这片土地的那些往事……

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: The great war waged for years between the evil forces of Traeh
rows.current: lang(Fox): 这场大战持续多年，交战双方是Traeh的邪恶势力

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: and the formerly peaceful Fenfen that inhabited this land.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 与曾经和平、居住在这片土地上的Fenfen。

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: It seemed to all that this war might go on forever, with no decisive victories.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 在所有人看来，这场战争或许会永远打下去，谁也无法取得决定性胜利。

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: Without a vital member of the Fenfen council representing a vital force
rows.current: lang(Fox): 议会失去了一位代表重要力量的 Fenfen 核心成员，

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: the remaining councilors were hamstrung.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 余下的议员便处处受制。

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: The psychic bonds between the members still held, requiring constant vigilance
rows.current: lang(Fox): 成员之间的灵能联结依然维系着，只是需要时刻保持警觉，

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: to keep dark forces from consuming more ESPers.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 以免黑暗力量吞噬更多超能力者。

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: ...but then, one day, an opportunity arose...
rows.current: lang(Fox): ……可是有一天，一个机会出现了……

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: A moment of psychic weakness left Traeh disarmed and distracted for but a moment
rows.current: lang(Fox): 心灵上的一时虚弱，让Traeh卸下防备、分了神，哪怕只有一瞬，

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: and in that moment the remaining members of the council struck!
rows.current: lang(Fox): 就在那一刻，其余议员出手了！

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: Unable to overcome the psychic disturbance and deal a final blow,
rows.current: lang(Fox): 无法克服这股灵能扰动、给出致命一击，

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: the councilors instead froze Traeh in a crystal prison.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 议员们转而将Traeh封冻在一座水晶囚牢之中。

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: With no fierce leader to guide them, the oppor- tunistic hordes broke apart
rows.current: lang(Fox): 没有了凶悍首领的指引，那群见风转舵的乌合之众土崩瓦解，

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: fleeing from the powers of the Fenfen council.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 纷纷逃离Fenfen理事会的力量。

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: This is not to say that it was a triumphant moment for the Fenfen...
rows.current: lang(Fox): 这并不是说，对Fenfen而言这是一个凯旋的时刻……

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: Indeed, heavy prices were paid on both sides of the conflict.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 事实上，冲突的双方都付出了惨重的代价。

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: The planet you landed on is no longer the peaceful home of the Fenfen
rows.current: lang(Fox): 你所登陆的这颗星球，已不再是Fenfen那宁静的家园，

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: but merely a chaotic shadow of its former self.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 而只是往日模样的一个混沌残影。

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: Many Fenfen as of yet are held captive by remnants of the would-be conquerors
rows.current: lang(Fox): 至今仍有许多Fenfen被那些妄图征服者的残部俘虏着，

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: awaiting the day that a hero will free them...
rows.current: lang(Fox): 等待着有朝一日，一位英雄前来解救他们……

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: Oh brave hero, thank you for rescuing me and proving your courage.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 噢，勇敢的英雄，谢谢你救了我，证明了你的勇气。

rows.current: lang(Fox): 让心神向内，去见证塑造这片土地的那些往事……

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: As us Fenfen strove to rebuild our home and drive out the remnants of evil
rows.current: lang(Fox): 当我们Fenfen奋力重建家园、驱逐邪恶残部时，

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: some of us looked up into the sky and saw a shooting star coming down.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 我们中有些人仰望天空，看见一颗流星正坠落而下。

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: Perhaps Fate had sent us a hero, with which we could regain our peace?
rows.current: lang(Fox): 也许是命运给我们派来了一位英雄，好让我们重获和平？

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: Or perhaps Fate had a more sinister joke to play on us suffering Fenfen
rows.current: lang(Fox): 又或许，命运对受苦的我们Fenfen还有更阴险的玩笑要开，

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: for this visitor from the stars did not land on our planet proper...
rows.current: lang(Fox): 因为这位来自群星的访客，并没有降落在星球本体上……

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: ...instead, they landed on the satellite rock that held Traeh's prison!
rows.current: lang(Fox): ……而是落在了关押Traeh的囚牢所在的那座卫星岩上！

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: As if destined for only a single purpose, the interstellar interloper
rows.current: lang(Fox): 仿佛注定只有一个目的，那位星际闯入者

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: made their way to the very core of Traeh's prison.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 一路来到了关押Traeh的囚牢核心。

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: Had her psychic tendrils found their way into a poor fool's mind?
rows.current: lang(Fox): 她的灵能触须，是否已经探入了某个可怜虫的脑中？

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: There is no way to know if it was dark ESPer power at work or merely curiosity
rows.current: lang(Fox): 无从得知，究竟是黑暗的超能力者力量在作祟，还是仅仅出于好奇，

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: but this traveler made contact with the crystal prison that held Traeh...
rows.current: lang(Fox): 但这位旅者确实触碰到了关押Traeh的水晶囚牢……

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: ...and so they became undone, unable to resist the dark ESPer forces.
rows.current: lang(Fox): ……就这样，这名旅者崩溃了，无力抵挡黑暗的超能力者力量。

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: Power and pain coursed through the poor explorer
rows.current: lang(Fox): 力量与痛苦奔涌过这名可怜的探索者全身，

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: until their mind was no longer their own.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 直到那心智，再也不属于自己。

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: No, from that moment forth they answered to a darker power...
rows.current: lang(Fox): 不，从那一刻起，那位旅者便听命于一股更黑暗的力量……

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: They did as Traeh commanded!
rows.current: lang(Fox): Traeh吩咐什么，那位旅者就照做！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Now... Yiffai, you're gonna have to wake up for me!
rows.current: text: 现在……伊吠，你一定要醒过来啊！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: If you're not still in there... I don't, I don't know what I'd do!!
rows.current: text: 要是你已经不在里面了……我不，我不知道该怎么办！！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Uuhn... big sis... I remember you...
rows.current: text: 唔……姐姐……我记得你……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: In fact, getting knocked to the darn ground like this again...
rows.current: text: 说真的，又像这样被狠狠打倒在地……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: ...is makin' me remember you even more.
rows.current: text: ……反而让我更想起你了。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Like when we used to tussle... heh, you never did gimme a break...
rows.current: text: 就像以前我们打闹的时候……嘿，你可从来没让过我……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: ...my tough big sis, who taught me everything... and always looked out for me...
rows.current: text: ……我那厉害的姐姐，什么都教给了我……也一直护着我……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Yiffai... y-you're back!
rows.current: text: 伊吠……你、你回来了！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: I can't believe it... I thought... I thought I might have to...
rows.current: text: 真不敢相信……我以为……我以为自己可能不得不……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: But now you're safe again!
rows.current: text: 不过现在你又安全了！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Nnf... might need a little help standing.
rows.current: text: 唔……可能得扶我一把才能站起来。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: That beating you dished out was one thing... but that's not all...
rows.current: text: 你把我揍成这样是一回事……但还不止如此……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: I was under the control of... a queen. Dark and cruel.
rows.current: text: 我之前被……一位女王控制着。她阴暗又残忍。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Feels like she sapped most of the energy I had left, when her will left me.
rows.current: text: 感觉她的意志离开我时，把我剩下的大半力气也抽走了。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: I might not be able to swing a tazer for a while... but here, take this.
rows.current: text: 我可能有一阵子挥不动电击枪了……不过，来，拿着这个。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: It's dad's old whistle. You gave it to me for my first mission, remember...?
rows.current: text: 这是爸爸的旧哨子。我第一次出任务时，你把它给了我，还记得吗……？

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: I'll pilot your ship, and wherever you blow the whistle, I'll pick you up!
rows.current: text: 我来驾驶你的飞船，不管你在哪儿吹响哨子，我都会去接你！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: That's the least I can do for saving me, right...?
rows.current: text: 你救了我，这至少是我该做的，对吧……？

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Ahh! Sorry lad! I don't know what came over me there!
rows.current: text: 啊！抱歉，小伙子！我也不知道刚才怎么鬼迷心窍了！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: ...Or what came over my tazer, for that matter...
rows.current: text: ……或者该问，我的电击枪又是怎么了……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: ...wait no that was me...
rows.current: text: ……等等，不对，那是我……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Let's start at the beginning, shall we?
rows.current: text: 咱们从头说起，好吗？

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: A shame you had to see me like that, but it's not really my fault.
rows.current: text: 可惜让你看见我那副样子，可这真不是我的错。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: It all began when I stumbled upon a group of Dwarves in the midst of scouting.
rows.current: text: 一切都始于侦察时，我偶遇了一群矮人。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: I was too engrossed in mapping out this large mine area that they call Ayskammr
rows.current: text: 我太专心绘制那片叫艾斯卡姆的大矿区地图了，所以壮汉们突然撕扯我的制服，让我措手不及！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: so I was caught off guard as the burly boys started to tear at my uniform!

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: I probably don't have to explain it, but I of course held back while fighting
rows.current: text: 这大概不用解释，打斗时我当然手下留情了。我壮得如此惊人，当然担心伤着那些可怜的矮人。他们显然对练肌肉也只是稍有兴趣，但可惜，他们跟我根本没法比。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: being as prodigiously buff as I am, I worried about hurting the poor Dwarves

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: they clearly had taken a passing interest in muscular development, but alas

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: there was just no comparison between us.

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: While holding back, one of the boys quite rudely grabbed my tail. Scandalous!
rows.current: text: 我正手下留情，一个家伙却无礼地抓住我的尾巴。太不像话！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Such rudeness was no way to repay the kindness that I showed them. Nosirree.
rows.current: text: 我好心待他们，他们却这么无礼，哪有这种道理！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: It was enough to make a man consider teaching the brash lad a /proper/ lesson.
rows.current: text: 真让人想给那冒失小子一个/像样/的教训。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: As I considered a fitting punishment, the Dwarf seemed inclined to escalate things
rows.current: text: 我正琢磨该怎么惩罚，那矮人似乎还想得寸进尺，也就是那时，我决定认真起来。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: and it was at that point that I decided to take things seriously.

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Treating me like I was a common boylass for them to enjoy, such nerve.
rows.current: text: 竟把我当成随便给他们玩弄的男婊子，真是放肆。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: In a burst of fairness I tried to warn the crudes that they were about to be
rows.current: text: 出于公平，我还好心警告那群粗人，接下来他们就要承受我使出全力的一击。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: on the receiving end of my full power.

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: The poor kids didn't know what they were bringing on themselves...
rows.current: text: 那帮可怜的小子，根本不知自己惹上了什么……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Luckily for the brats, an interloper came along before I showed them whatfor!
rows.current: text: 算那帮崽子走运，我正要教训他们，就来了个搅局的！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: I unclenched my... fist... and breathed a sigh of relief.
rows.current: text: 我松开紧握的……拳头……长舒了一口气。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: A gentleman such as I hates to resort to violence, as should be apparent.
rows.current: text: 像我这样的绅士，显然最不愿诉诸暴力。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: It was then that the youngsters decided to hightail out of the vicinity
rows.current: text: 看清自己面对的是什么后，那帮小子都吓破了胆，决定夹着尾巴逃离此地。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: being overcome with coward- ice once they realized what they were up against.

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: I gave them a word or two of advice while they retreated, for good measure.
rows.current: text: 他们撤退时，我还好心补了几句忠告。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Now this is where things start to get a bit hazy. Uncharacteristically so...
rows.current: text: 从这儿起，记忆就有点模糊了。这可不像我平时的记性……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: I turned to introduce myself to the fella that had chanced upon the scene
rows.current: text: 我转身向那个碰巧路过的家伙自我介绍，然后……我就记不太清了……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: and then... I can't recall much...

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: ...some mesmerizing light... ...warm and... grabby...?
rows.current: text: ……某种迷人的光……暖暖的……还会乱摸……？

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Yes that's right, I was just about to warn the fella to leave the fighting to me
rows.current: text: 对，没错，我正要叫那家伙把战斗交给我，可我记得自己好像被……几只幽灵手抓住了？

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: but I think I was in the clutches of... some ghostly hands?

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: No, that can't be right. I think there was some weapon that he may have aimed at me
rows.current: text: 不，不可能。我想他或许拿某种武器对准了我，当然，也不是说有什么武器是我应付不了的。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: not that there's no weapon I can't handle, of course.

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Right, of course, that must have been it. The cad sudd- enly engaged in shenanigans
rows.current: text: 对，没错，肯定是这样。那无赖突然耍起花招，逼得我只好一遍遍用手“回敬”他！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: and I was forced to beat him off repeatedly!

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: If memory serves me correct, I was doing such a good job at defending myself
rows.current: text: 没记错的话，我的自卫实在太出色，连那位大人都夸我是个乖孩子。真是光荣时刻！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: that his lordship considered me to be a very good boy. A proud hour!

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Hold on, no... what? Why would I be a good boy...
rows.current: text: 等等，不……什么？我怎么会是乖孩子……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: why would those words fill me with glee, even now...
rows.current: text: 为什么就算现在，听到这话还是会满心欢喜……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Disregard whatever nonsense was recorded then, clearly it's unreliable.
rows.current: text: 那时候录下的胡话别当真，显然不可靠。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: The important thing is that when you found me, I had been left alone in this cell
rows.current: text: 重点是，你找到我时，我已被独自丢在这间牢房里，除了那把没电的电击枪，什么消遣也没有，只有那挥不去的渴望，想再被夸一句乖孩子。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: with naught to entertain myself with but my de-energized tazer

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: and a lingering desire to be called a good boy once more.

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Thankfully, a good bop on the snout returned me to my rightful state of mind!
rows.current: text: 幸好鼻头挨了一记，我就彻底清醒了！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: If you find any map data disks out in these mines, there's no need to thank me.
rows.current: text: 要是你在矿井里找到地图数据盘，不用谢我。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: It's all in a day's work for this...
rows.current: text: 对我这个……来说，都只是分内的工作……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: good...
rows.current: text: 乖……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: boy...?
rows.current: text: 孩子……？

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Eep! Sorry! I mean... t-thanks!
rows.current: text: 呀！抱歉！我是说……呃，谢、谢谢！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Been a while since I got to give my legs a good stretch!
rows.current: text: 好久没机会好好伸展一下双腿了！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Not that those vines weren't comfy or anything, after you get used to them...
rows.current: text: 也不能说那些藤蔓不舒服吧，等你习惯了之后……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: ...not that I was here long, mind you!
rows.current: text: ……不过提醒你一句，我在这儿可没待多久。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Last time I was able to stretch my legs properly was just after entering Sceafya
rows.current: text: 我上一次能好好伸展双腿，还是刚进斯凯菲亚的时候，在那片灌木丛里爬来爬去，好把这片地方摸清楚。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: crawling through all this shrubbery in order to scope out the area.

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: I thought I was doing real good to have gotten this far without getting caught!
rows.current: text: 我还以为自己干得漂亮，能一路走到这儿都没被发现！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: ...but there was someone behind me for who-knows-how-long
rows.current: text: ……可我身后不知什么时候多了个人，谁知道已经跟了多久，也许从我开始自以为在潜行时就在了，呀！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: maybe for the whole time I thought I was being stealthy for, eep!

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: I'm not really one for direct combat, but as far as I could tell
rows.current: text: 我其实不太擅长正面冲突，不过据我判断，这一次实在别无选择……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: I had no choice this time around...

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: This poor Elven gal thought she had the upper hand and didn't even try to attack
rows.current: text: 这个可怜的精灵姑娘以为自己占了上风，连攻击都没试着来一下，可我偏偏摆出了小熊猫族的传统战斗姿势！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: but I went and assumed the traditional combat pose of the Red Pandarians!

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: She knew that she made a possibly fatal mistake, because shortly after that
rows.current: text: 她知道自己可能犯了个要命的错误，因为没过多久，她便拔出了她的精灵剑，剑尖朝向我。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: she drew her Elven blade and pointed it my way.

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: I offered her the opportunity to surrender before I unleashed a fury
rows.current: text: 在我大发雷霆之前，我给了她投降的机会，唯一的要求，就是她得带我去她的营地。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: with the only stipulation being that she take me to her encampment.

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: To nobody's surprise, of course, she instantly gave up and gave in
rows.current: text: 当然，不出所料，她马上就放弃抵抗、屈服了，甚至还招呼朋友来帮忙，把我固定在他们传统的那种箩筐上！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: even hailing for friends to help affix me to their traditional hamper of sorts!

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Not one to deny courtesies, I allowed them to do as they wished.
rows.current: text: 我从来不会推辞人家的礼数，就由着他们想怎样就怎样。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: And I must say they treated me like a proper victor, they did!
rows.current: text: 而且我得说，他们确实把我当成了真正的胜者！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Once in their encampment, I was quickly showered with affection and gifts
rows.current: text: 一进他们的营地，我就立刻被关爱和礼物包围了。刚从箩筐里解开、才要安顿下来，他们就给我按摩肩膀，还让我变得……咳咳……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: barely managed to make myself at home after being undone from the hamper

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: that I was being given shoulder massages and being made... ahem...

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: ...even more /comfortable/...
rows.current: text: ……更加/舒服/……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Ahh the ladies, that is to say, the Elves... for they're all ladies...
rows.current: text: 啊哈，那些女士——也就是说，精灵……毕竟她们全都是女士……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: they were most insistent on making me comfortable in all manner of ways!
rows.current: text: 她们可是用尽各种法子，非要让我舒服不可！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: I did my best to make it known that I was a merciful victor
rows.current: text: 我尽力让她们知道，我是个仁慈的胜者，也表明她们不该做任何自己不舒服的事……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: and that they shouldn't do anything they weren't comfortable with...

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: ...but it seems that my prowess impressed upon them far too strongly.
rows.current: text: ……不过看来，我那番本事给她们留下的印象实在太过深刻。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Yes, even into the wee hours of the night, the Elves insisted on comforting me
rows.current: text: 没错，就连夜深人静的时候，精灵们也坚持要安抚我。我想也是，她们遇到的英雄都该是强壮又雄健的。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: I suppose it's expected that all heroes they meet would be strong and virile.

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: It's not as if I'm not without an appetite, of course.
rows.current: text: 当然，我也不是没有胃口。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: My power and physique aren't compensation for any other male aspects!
rows.current: text: 我的力量和体格，可不是在弥补我男性方面其他地方的不足！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: There was hardly a moment when any Elven maid wasn't around to tend to my needs
rows.current: text: 几乎每一刻，都有精灵女仆在我身边照料我的需求。就连我想继续执行任务时，精灵们也紧紧跟在我身后，可以说，她们简直对伟大英雄的种子上了瘾！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: even when I attempted to continue with my mission, the Elves were at my heels

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: seemingly addicted to the seed of a great Hero, one might say!

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: It almost seemed like I'd never continue with the sortie...
rows.current: text: 看起来我几乎再也没法继续这次出击了……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: If it weren't the height of rudeness to sneak away, I would have done so
rows.current: text: 要不是偷偷溜走实在太过失礼，我早就溜了，因为我开始担心其他特工出了什么事。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: for I was beginning to worry about what was happening with the other agents.

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Obviously not all Cosmobreeders are as strong as I am, clearly.
rows.current: text: 显然不是所有宇宙育种者都像我这么强，这很明显。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: And it's those sorts of thoughts that occupied me off and on, day after day...
rows.current: text: 这类念头就这样断断续续地占据着我，一天又一天……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: It was in the midst one such line of thinking that I came to realize...
rows.current: text: 正想着这些，我才突然发现……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: ...the Elves were gone!
rows.current: text: ……精灵们不见了！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: ...but I was stuck! The treacherous vixens only pretended to surrender!
rows.current: text: ……可我还被困着！那些背信弃义的泼妇，原来只是假装投降！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Before they moved camp, they left me here in this tentacle-ridden cell
rows.current: text: 她们转移营地前，把我留在了这间满是触手的牢房里。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Well! The nerve of them!
rows.current: text: 好哇！她们竟敢这样！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: I was just about to break free from these dastardly noodles before you showed up
rows.current: text: 在你出现之前，我眼看就要从这些可恶的面条里挣脱出来了。啊啊，而且我想，让你又能往成就清单上添一笔“救援”，对你这样的新特工来说，也更体面些，不是吗？

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: aaaand I suppose it looks better for a new agent such as yourself

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: if you get to add another "rescue" to your list of accomplishments, no?

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Well go on, I'll be right along after stretching my legs.
rows.current: text: 快去吧，我伸展完双腿就跟上。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Heck, maybe you deserve the chance to try save this planet first
rows.current: text: 哼，新人，算我今天大方，也许该让你先去试着拯救这颗星球……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: now that I'm feeling generous to you, newbie...

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: Oh brave hero, thank you for rescuing me and proving your courage.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 勇敢的英雄啊，感谢你救出我，证明了你的勇气。

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: Now, place your hands upon mine.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 现在，把你的双手放在我的手上。

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: Turn your mind inward and witness the events that have shaped these lands...
rows.current: lang(Fox): 将心神转向内在，见证塑造这片土地的往事……

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: The great war waged for years between the evil forces of Traeh
rows.current: lang(Fox): 这场大战持续多年，交战双方是Traeh的邪恶势力

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: and the formerly peaceful Fenfen that inhabited this land.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 和这片土地上原本爱好和平的Fenfen。

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: It seemed to all that this war might go on forever, with no decisive victories.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 所有人都觉得，这场战争也许永无休止，谁也无法彻底取胜。

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: Without a vital member of the Fenfen council representing a vital force
rows.current: lang(Fox): 议会失去了一位代表重要力量的 Fenfen 核心成员，

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: the remaining councilors were hamstrung.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 余下的议员便处处受制。

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: The psychic bonds between the members still held, requiring constant vigilance
rows.current: lang(Fox): 成员之间的灵能联结依然维系着，只是需要时刻保持警觉，

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: to keep dark forces from consuming more ESPers.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 以免黑暗力量吞噬更多超能力者。

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: ...but then, one day, an opportunity arose...
rows.current: lang(Fox): ……但有一天，机会终于来了……

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: A moment of psychic weakness left Traeh disarmed and distracted for but a moment
rows.current: lang(Fox): 心灵上的一时虚弱，让Traeh卸下防备、分了神，哪怕只有一瞬，

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: and in that moment the remaining members of the council struck!
rows.current: lang(Fox): 就在那一刻，其余议员出手了！

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: Unable to overcome the psychic disturbance and deal a final blow,
rows.current: lang(Fox): 议员们无法克服这股灵能扰动，给她致命一击，

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: the councilors instead froze Traeh in a crystal prison.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 只好改将Traeh封冻在水晶牢笼里。

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: With no fierce leader to guide them, the oppor- tunistic hordes broke apart
rows.current: lang(Fox): 失去凶悍首领的指挥，那群投机者便四散溃逃，

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: fleeing from the powers of the Fenfen council.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 躲避Fenfen议会的力量。

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: This is not to say that it was a triumphant moment for the Fenfen...
rows.current: lang(Fox): 但这并不意味着Fenfen迎来了凯旋时刻……

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: Indeed, heavy prices were paid on both sides of the conflict.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 确实，冲突双方都付出了惨重代价。

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: The planet you landed on is no longer the peaceful home of the Fenfen
rows.current: lang(Fox): 你降落的这颗星球，已不再是Fenfen宁静的家园，

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: but merely a chaotic shadow of its former self.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 只剩下往日家园支离混乱的影子。

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: Many Fenfen as of yet are held captive by remnants of the would-be conquerors
rows.current: lang(Fox): 至今，仍有许多Fenfen被那些妄图征服我们的残党囚禁

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: awaiting the day that a hero will free them...
rows.current: lang(Fox): 等待着英雄前来解救的那一天……

rows.source: Heh! Heh! Heh!
rows.current: text: 嘿！嘿！嘿！

rows.source: Some of you little folks have some proper fight in you... Heh!
rows.current: text: 你们这帮小个子里，还真有几个能打的……嘿！

rows.source: I'd almost thought that the lot of you were merely an annoyance
rows.current: text: 我差点以为你们这群家伙只会惹人烦，没想到还真有个打中了我。呵！

rows.source: but here's one that actually manged to hit me. Heh!
What's next, one of you coming along and knocking me down to-
rows.current: text: 接下来呢，你们还想来一个把我也撞——

rows.source: Come on, I beat you fair and square! Stop trying to act cool.
rows.current: text: 得了，我可是堂堂正正打赢你的！别装酷了。

rows.source: You know I'm a better fighter, and I accept your defeat.
rows.current: text: 你知道我身手更强，我也接受你的认输。

rows.source: No more harm will come to you so long as you tell me whe-
rows.current: text: 不会再伤你，只要告诉我在—

rows.source: W-what?? How did you get behind me so fast???
rows.current: text: 什、什么？？你怎么一下就到我背后了？？？

rows.source: Harm? My little yellow furred companion? You wish to tell me of harm?
rows.current: text: 伤害？黄毛小朋友，你要跟我谈伤害？

rows.source: Perhaps you'd like a lesson in just such a topic as "harm"
rows.current: text: 也许你想亲自上一堂关于“伤害”的课

rows.source: and then you can recite it to me, no?
rows.current: text: 然后再背给我听，如何？
text: ……好痛……

rows.source: Y-yeah... I can... I can tell you a lot about harm... now.... oow....
rows.current: text: 是、是啊……现在……伤害这事，我懂得可多了……嗷……

rows.source: ...j-just lemme get my breath back...
rows.current: text: ……就、就让我喘口气……

rows.source: Here, spunky yellow boy. Take your leave of my domain.
rows.current: text: 好吧，有股冲劲的黄毛小子，离开我的领地吧。

rows.source: And while you're at it, take this garbage that a fellow small fighter left
rows.current: text: 顺便，把另一个小个子战士留下的垃圾带走。我当时给他的教训，可比给你的还要狠。

rows.source: after I had given him an even rougher lesson than yours.
With shoes in hand, Yiffai scrambles out as the Redbull drops deeper into the mines
rows.current: text: 伊吠拿着靴子爬出去，红牛则深入矿井，他泛着红光的鬃毛诡异地隐入黑暗……

rows.source: his glowing red mane fading eerily into the dark...

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Thou hast fought a fair round for such an untrained hand.
rows.current: lang(HardFox): 汝虽未经锤炼，这一战却也打得不差。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Pray, tell me thine name so that I may honor thee.
rows.current: lang(HardFox): 敢问阁下尊姓大名，好让吾致以敬意。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: ...ahh, but the people of thy land do not speaketh my tongue...
rows.current: lang(HardFox): ……啊，然而汝故土之民，并不通晓吾之言语……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: W-what? No matter how much I fight... There's just no winning!
rows.current: text: 什、什么？再怎么打……都赢不了！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Who are you? W-what are you doing down here?
rows.current: text: 你是谁？你、你在下面做什么？

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: I need not speaketh your crude tongue in order to understand your crude desire
rows.current: lang(HardFox): 无需说汝那粗鄙之语，吾亦明了汝粗鄙之欲

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: So struggle not as I placeth a most useful trinket upon thee.
rows.current: lang(HardFox): 莫要挣扎，且让吾为汝戴上这实用的小饰物。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: H-hey! What the hell is this? I'm not some darn pet of yours to collar!
rows.current: text: 喂、喂！搞什么鬼？我又不是你家宠物，戴什么项圈！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: I'll find a way to bring you down, just give me a minute and I'll-
rows.current: text: 我会想办法打倒你的，给我一分钟，我就——

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: And thou shall do what, fairest knight?
rows.current: text: 那么，俊美的骑士，汝又待如何？

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Mine powers are ancient and forgotten, and thou are but a pup lost in the dark.
rows.current: text: 吾之力量古老而被世人遗忘，汝不过是迷失黑暗的小犬。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Prayeth that I overlook your ill mannered outburst, as the generous host I am.
rows.current: text: 祈求吾这位宽宏的主人，不计较汝方才的无礼罢。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Now taketh this necklace so that you may understand others of this land
rows.current: text: 且收下这项链，好让汝听懂此地众人的话语……也省得旁人再领教汝的无礼……呵呵呵呵……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: ...and spareth them from your ill manners...eh heh heh heh...

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: And with a gutteral laugh, the demonic form faded back into the darkest darks
rows.current: text: 伴着喉间一阵低笑，那魔影退回了最深的黑暗，只留下一个吓坏了的小狗崽……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: leaving nought but a scared pup in his wake...

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Now WHY did you have to go and do that, huh?
rows.current: text: 现在，你干嘛非得去干那种事，嗯？

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: One of you sorts went and ransacked all my belongings right after I landed
rows.current: text: 你们这种家伙前脚在我刚落地时把我的所有家当翻了个精光，如今你又想在一对一单挑里把我打倒？

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: and now you're trying to take me down in one-on-one combat?

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: No chance! I've just about had enough of you little bra-
rows.current: text: 没门！我真是受够了你们这些小混-

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: -hey...
rows.current: text: -嘿……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Is that... No way...
rows.current: text: 那是……不可能吧……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.current: text: ……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: ...but YES way!
rows.current: text: ……可偏偏就是！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: It's my Cosmohelm! It got all the way over here somehow!
rows.current: text: 是我的Cosmohelm！它不知怎么一路跑到这边来了！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: This'll be real good to have in case I ever have to go into space or something!
rows.current: text: 万一哪天我得上太空什么的，这玩意儿可就派上大用场了！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Just need to keep an eye out for the Cosmosuit portion...
rows.current: text: 只要再留心Cosmosuit那一部分就好...

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: ...and I'll be able to have a nice proper airtight outfit! Hoorah!
rows.current: text: ……我就能凑齐一套像样的气密装备啦！好耶！
